title: Can Multipartite Entanglement Probe Wormhole Moduli Invisible to Bipartite Entanglement?
summary: We ask whether multipartite entanglement can probe bulk moduli invisible to bipartite entanglement. We study this question in an explicit family of four-boundary AdS$_3$ wormholes related by a Fenchel-Nielsen twist $τ$, asking whether the complete set of bipartite RT entropies can remain exactly $τ$-independent while the holographic $\mathtt q=4$ multi-entropy is sensitive to the twist.
